scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix mock-api install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix mock-api run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix mock-api install --include=dev && npm --prefix mock-api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix mock-api run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
